# `/brandings` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /brandings/v1

`getBrandingListV1` — List of branding items

This API endpoint returns a list of branding items.

- Scopes: idn:branding:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Returns 200: array of brandingitem

### POST /brandings/v1

`createBrandingItemV1` — Create a branding item

This API endpoint creates a branding item.

- Scopes: idn:branding:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (multipart/form-data): brandingitemcreate
- Returns 201: brandingitem

### DELETE /brandings/v1/default

`deleteDefaultBrandingV1` — Clear the default branding item

This API endpoint clears the customizable properties of the default branding item. The default item is kept.

- Scopes: idn:branding:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Returns 204: no body

### GET /brandings/v1/{name}

`getBrandingV1` — Get a branding item

This API endpoint retrieves information for an existing branding item by name.

- Scopes: idn:branding:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `name` (path, required) — The name of the branding item to be retrieved
- Returns 200: brandingitem

### PUT /brandings/v1/{name}

`setBrandingItemV1` — Update a branding item

This API endpoint updates information for an existing branding item.

- Scopes: idn:branding:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `name` (path, required) — The name of the branding item to be retrieved
- Body (multipart/form-data): brandingitemcreate
- Returns 200: brandingitem

### DELETE /brandings/v1/{name}

`deleteBrandingV1` — Delete a branding item

This API endpoint delete information for an existing branding item by name.

- Scopes: idn:branding:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `name` (path, required) — The name of the branding item to be deleted
- Returns 204: no body
